name: Olost (Spain)
description: Divided per bend sinister red and white with a yellow bend sinister charged with four red bars, the red bearing the white church of the arms and the white a red lion.
history: The flag was approved on 2 June 1999 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, bicolour per bend sinister red and white, with a yellow bend sinister 1/4 of the height charged with four red bars, and the figures of the arms, each 1/3 of the height and 1/5 of the length.
